remarks: Just 1/2 mile from Greenwich Avenue, this updated Downtown Greenwich apartment puts shopping, dining, the newly renovated Greenwich Metro-North station, and the new Greenwich Crossing development close by. I-95 access is approximately 1/4 mile away, providing convenient access to New York City and Stamford.  Inside, the second-floor bathroom has been completely renovated with a new tile tub/shower, flooring, vanity, mirror, and toilet. The apartment also features fresh paint downstairs, a new stainless-steel refrigerator and oven, plus the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer!  Two off-street parking spaces are included, along with garbage pickup, cold water, landscaping, snow removal, and multiple window A/C units. Outside, enjoy a shared backyard with space for grilling, entertaining, or relaxing. With Greenwich Avenue, Greenwich Crossing, Metro-North, restaurants, shops, and everyday conveniences all within 1/2 mile, this apartment offers an excellent combination of location, updates, and convenience in the heart of Greenwich.
